title: No Barriers Reef
intro:
Crystal-clear waters and a thriving marine ecosystem have made the Belize Barrier Reef one of the world’s most celebrated dive destinations. Each year, travelers experience its beauty firsthand. But for many Belizeans living closest to it, physical barriers have kept the reef out of reach.

This film captured the moment those barriers fell. By bringing the reef to Belizeans with physical disabilities through immersive VR, it transformed access into emotion, creating moments of connection, gratitude, and inclusion. The film became a catalyst for conversation around accessibility and conservation.

sections.title: Social Teasers & Influencers
sections.body: As World Oceans Day approached, we teased the emotional impact of the immersive experience. We then partnered with Belizean and accessibility-focused influencers to drive awareness around the launch.

sections.title: Explore the Reef with VR / 360° Video
sections.body: We brought the 360° underwater journey to audiences online and through live events, allowing anyone to explore the beauty of the world’s largest living reef.

title: Be Like Mike
intro: Everyone wanted to Be Like Mike. So as the 23-year anniversary of Gatorade’s most iconic campaign approached, we saw an opportunity not to recreate it, but to reintroduce it to a new generation. Today’s teen athletes don’t just say who inspires them, they show it. Using #BeLikeMike, they turned a legendary idea into something personal, social, and alive again. The result helped make this the most viewed campaign in Gatorade’s history.

sections.title: NBA All-Star Event
sections.body: We launched #BeLikeMike with a live event during NBA All-Star Weekend, transporting teens back in time and allowing them to recreate Michael Jordan’s most iconic moments.

sections.title: Social
sections.body: The love for #23 poured in, as amateur and professional athletes took to social, showing us, in their own way, how they #BeLikeMike.

sections.title: Capstone Video
sections.body: In the end, we curated their best submissions into a capstone piece set to the original commercial’s song, proving we all still want to Be Like Mike.

sections.title: ESPN HPTO
sections.body: We worked with ESPN to build a custom homepage takeover, launching their new site redesign while celebrating one of MJ's most iconic moments.

title: Just Right
intro: Thrifty Car Rental has always delivered the right balance of value and quality, but few people knew it. To drive awareness and consideration, we launched Thrifty’s first TV campaign in over a decade, reimagining a familiar story with a bit of humorswagg™. Starring Kenan Thompson as Goldilocks, the work proved that “just right” can still stand out.

sections.title: :06 OLVs
sections.body: Kenan Thompson = :06 gold. These scripted and improvised videos were used in social and paid placements to keep Thrifty top of mind.

title: Live the Pig
intro: There are two kinds of people in this world. Those who love The Pig, and those who have never experienced The Pig. We let pig evangelists introduce the brand to those who may not know about all the amazing reasons to love The Pig.

sections.title: Departments TV
sections.body: We brought our fun brand voice and identity to life in animated spots highlighting different departments.

title: G Recover
intro: Gatorade entered the crowded protein category with its own shakes and bars, and with a clear goal: make the packaging impossible to miss. We created dramatic, hand-crafted stop-motion videos with the four major sports leagues, putting the product front and center. The films showed teen athletes that Gatorade isn’t just trusted for in-game hydration, but also for post-game nutrition.

sections.title: Instagram Recover Journey
sections.body: Using link tagging, teen athletes were invited into a “choose your own path” experience that helped them get more out of every workout. Guided by Gatorade’s youngest roster athlete, Jabari Parker, the journey unfolded through striking imagery, GIFs, and video, pairing real training moments with protein usage and workout tips straight from the pros.

productionCredit: Instagram Recover Journey Photographer: Dennis Leupold

title: Grab Life
intro:
Grab Life was created to position Belize as an accessible destination for adventure seekers, but as traveler priorities shifted post-pandemic, the platform evolved. Adventure alone was no longer enough. Travelers were seeking culture, meaning, and well-being alongside exploration.

We introduced the Grab Life Coaches of Mind, Body, and Soul, grounding the campaign in real Belizeans who embody the destination. Mind focused on wellness and restoration, Soul celebrated culture and heritage, and Body carried forward the spirit of adventure from reef to rainforest. The result was a campaign that let Belizeans lead the story, inviting travelers to experience Belize not just as a place to visit, but a place to feel.

sections.title: Owned Channel Integration
sections.body: The Grab Life Coaches extended into social and Belize’s trip-planning app, guiding travelers with personalized itineraries, curated recommendations, and a chatbot that spoke in the voice of a coach, turning inspiration into action.

sections.title: Grab Life Activation
sections.body: We showed people how to grab life spiritually, physically, and culturally. Then we invited them to literally grab life as a human claw machine.

title: Behind the Sweat
intro:
From the time we start playing sports, we pretend to be our idols. To show teen athletes what it truly takes to become the best, we created a campaign that allowed teens to become their favorite pro athletes through a variety of immersive experiences.

We created first person POV videos featuring Usain Bolt and Serena Williams, a 360° Virtual Reality experience featuring JJ Watt, and partnered with Spotify to allow users to choose workout playlists that match the intensity and training style of the featured pros.

sections.title: JJ Watt VR / 360° Video
sections.body: We created an immersive VR experience allowing aspiring pros to become JJ Watt. Using a custom-built VR array and binaural audio, we delivered an unprecedented live-action point of view of the speed, strength and sweat of JJ Watt.

sections.title: VR Roadshow
sections.body: The VR experience toured at sports camps and events across the country. It was also featured as one of the first branded YouTube 360° videos.

sections.title: Spotify Integration
sections.body: Partnering with Spotify, we were able to give athletes playlists that matched the musical tastes and training styles of our pros: Power, Agility & Speed.

title: Family Network
intro: T-Mobile is the definitive challenger brand, fearlessly taking on giants like AT&T and Verizon. That ambition led to bold, category-breaking offers for families and unconventional partnerships, including the NBA.
productionCredit: Kids Are Free Director: Errol Morris

title: Extra Miler
intro: Hertz unseated Enterprise as #1 in the J.D. Power customer satisfaction ranking in car rental for the first time ever. So we built a campaign that gave the credit to the people who earned it: Hertz customers.

sections.title: Times Square Takeover
sections.body: Hertz’s return to the NASDAQ was a defining brand moment. To announce its re-IPO and the acquisition of the world’s largest EV fleet, we designed a ten-screen Times Square system engineered to work as a single, cohesive experience across different formats and sightlines. The takeover cut through the visual noise of Times Square while reinforcing Hertz’s bold, modern brand presence at a critical point in its comeback.

title: ALL THAT
intro:
We reframed Rhode Island’s small size as a strength, positioning the state as a year-round destination packed with culture, cuisine, and experiences in close proximity. The campaign challenged the idea that “small” means limited, instead embracing an intentionally overwhelming mix of activities, sights, and flavors to express the feeling of ALL THAT.

New technologies and bold, unexpected activations helped bring the idea to life beyond traditional media. The result was a destination brand expression that feels unapologetically full, confident, and anything but small.

sections.title: Augmented Reality Portals Experience
sections.body:
We created an immersive augmented reality experience that allowed users to explore six iconic Rhode Island landmarks through interactive AR portals. Accessible on mobile devices, the experience transformed any physical space into a window onto the Ocean State. Designed to spark curiosity and inspire travel, it delivered high-impact brand storytelling in a simple, intuitive way.

We custom-designed a large-scale video wall installation for high-traffic locations to promote the AR experience and drive QR code scans.

sections.title: Saks Fifth Avenue Partnership
sections.body: Rhode Island has inspired luxury travel since the Gilded Age, and high-income travelers remain a priority audience today. We partnered with Saks Fifth Avenue to reach that audience through an integrated campaign featuring iconic window displays in New York City. The effort extended to in-store displays in key direct-flight markets, supported by social and digital content showcasing curated Saks fashion for a Rhode Island getaway.

sections.title: The Giant Travelling Stuffie Installation
sections.body: To highlight Rhode Island as a culinary destination, we transformed its iconic “stuffie” into a giant, three-dimensional installation placed in high-traffic airports nationwide to promote direct flights. The idea gained traction quickly and expanded into a traveling Stuffie Truck, touring events across the country and turning a local delicacy into a highly shareable, awareness-driving moment.

productionCredit: Digital Development Partner (AR Portals Experience): DPT

title: Pay With A Connection
intro: What’s the value of real connection in a screen-obsessed world? We ran a simple experiment: share a meal, put the phone away, and see what happens. Would you give up your phone for a few minutes if it meant free McDonald’s fries?

title: Futureself Timeline
intro: Financial planning is often overwhelming and number-driven. So we created an intuitive planning tool that helped people visualize their financial futures without a single number, using simple drag-and-drop life events to make complex decisions feel approachable and human. The site helped Lincoln win an Effie for its Futureself campaign.

sections.title: Things Change
sections.body: In the wake of a major market downturn, investor confidence was shaken. Our challenge was to reassure people that while their plans may have changed, Lincoln Financial Group would remain a steady guide, helping them navigate uncertainty, rebuild confidence, and stay on track toward their long-term goals.

title: Store It
intro: Pack rats love PODS. They also love perusing the classifieds section looking for more junk to accumulate. So we met them where they hunt, with print ads hiding in plain sight in the local classifieds.

title: Beach On
intro: Daytona Beach has long been known as a spring break party destination. But the brand set out to redefine itself as an easy, welcoming place for families. Knowing the beach was the undeniable hero, we created a rallying cry that reestablished Daytona Beach as the authority on beach fun and the ultimate family beach vacation, grounded in the carefree memories made there.

sections.title: Times Square Anamorphic Billboard
sections.body: Daytona Beach is a favorite for local weekenders, but longer trips from out-of-state visitors needed a boost. To shift perception, we created an anamorphic billboard in Times Square, spotlighting new direct flights from NYC and showing how easy it is to trade cold for “Beach On” energy.

title: The Collections
intro:
The Palm Beaches is one of the most diverse destinations in the country, spanning 39 cities and offering everything from family travel to wellness, nature, and luxury. We turned that diversity into the idea itself, inviting travelers to curate their own “collection” and build a vacation tailored to them.

To break through a category full of predictable beach imagery, we introduced a distinctive tablescape system. Elevated, tactile, and modular, it allowed experiences, activities, and moments to be artfully arranged and recombined, signaling both variety and refinement at a glance. Built around key brand pillars, the campaign flexed seamlessly across audiences and individual cities, while maintaining a consistent visual language across all media.

title: T20 World Cup
intro: Cricket is one of the most watched sports in the world, and Barbados is one of its most desirable destinations. When the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup came to Barbados, we positioned the tournament not just as a sporting event, but as a once-in-a-lifetime travel moment by fusing cricket iconography with the island’s unmistakable beauty.

title: Reef with a Beef
intro:
Everyone talks about ocean pollution except the ones most affected. Sea life has no voice. So we gave it one. On World Oceans Day, we turned Belize’s most iconic resident, the Belize Barrier Reef, the largest living reef on Earth into “The Reef with a Beef,” an outspoken advocate for the oceans.

Taking to Twitter and Instagram, the Reef called out polluters directly while rallying environmental allies. Its unapologetic tone reflected the urgency of the issue: change behavior now, or lose what can’t be replaced. The campaign drove over 31,000 engagements, gave consumers clear guidance on protecting our seas, and delivered a 3.1% lift in brand recognition for Belize.

title: Global Football
intro:
Gatorade is synonymous with sports in the U.S. but has limited awareness abroad. We were tasked to launch the brand’s first true global marketing initiative, where we asked elite amateur footballers to demonstrate how their hard work translates to unreal performance on the pitch by uploading a video to GatoradeFootball.com. Five winners would get the chance to play, train and tour at seven of the most iconic clubs around the world.

We created a launch video to announce the contest, put on live events in London and NYC, and produced a myriad of branded video content, promoted and consumed by thirty key markets across the globe.

sections.title: Global Social Support
sections.body: We orchestrated global social support by our pro athletes and clubs, global content distribution partner Goal.com, and Gatorade accounts around the world to spread awareness of the campaign using #BeUnreal.

sections.title: London & NYC Experiential Events
sections.body: We invited the best youth footballers in London and New York to battle in a next-level soccer competition. The events gave the elite footballers a once in a lifetime experience, while helping seed submissions, generate content and create awareness.

sections.title: GatoradeFootball.com
sections.body: We developed GatoradeFootball.com as a content hub for all of Gatorade’s global initiatives. Accommodating five languages, the website housed Unreal Around the World content, top-box content from partner agencies, and profiles on budding semi-professional footballers across the globe.

sections.title: Winners Trip
sections.body: We documented the unreal journey of our five winners, releasing individual videos as exclusive content for use by our professional club partners. A long-form complete journey recap was also created to showcase the unreal trip in its entirety.

title: Digital & Social
intro: We made a lot of fun stuff on the NAPA brand team at VML. We were responsible for supporting NAPA Auto Parts U.S.A. and Canada, NAPA Racing, NAPA AUTOPRO, NAPA AutoCare, NAPA Truck Service Centers and NAPA.com.

sections.title: Smartest Car OLVs
sections.body: Smarter technology built into vehicles makes it harder and more expensive for your average joe to be able to fix his. We channeled our obnoxious inner Elon Musk to help people consider keeping the car they already own.

sections.title: NAPA AUTOPRO
sections.body: AUTOPROs are NAPA Canada's nationwide flagship service stations. One of their main focal points is promoting seasonal maintenance. We created attention-grabbing, seasonal key visuals used for in-store signage, fliers, social, and other digital placements.

sections.title: NAPA Racing: Swancho
sections.body: NAPA Racing experienced a huge spike in engagement when they showcased a line of faux Chase Elliott products. The Swancho built off the irreverent tone of the NAPA Racing brand, bringing the actual product to life with its own infomercial and social campaign.

sections.title: NAPA Online: E-comm Site & Email
sections.body: I served as VML's creative lead for NAPA Online. Collaborating with planners and email specialists, we implemented the right touch points in the right places at the right times. Then my team and I went to work to make every asset delivered look and sound undeniably NAPA.

title: Print
intro: Connelly billiards tables are the finest money can buy. Our print campaign positioned them as the most valued possession you'll ever own.

title: ILTM Cannes Takeover
intro:
Leading Hotels of the World (LHW) is the world’s largest collection of exclusive, independent luxury hotels, each property representing the highest standard of service and hospitality. International Luxury Trade Market Cannes is the premier annual gathering of the global luxury travel industry.

To reinforce LHW’s position as the definitive leader in luxury, we were challenged to create a full signage takeover of the event. The solution centered on elegantly curated imagery and a bold, brand-forward identity, maintaining impeccable consistency while showcasing the scale, diversity, and prestige of LHW’s portfolio.

title: Digital & POP
intro: Bdubs has a fun-loving, aggro-irreverent tone. It was a lot of fun infusing that brand essence into every piece we made, from banners to menu inserts.

sections.title: Sauce Racers
sections.body: Beckoning the spine-tingling excitement of a classic ballpark mascot race, we created a captivating rich media experience featuring BWW sauces.

sections.title: March Madness ESPN Homepage Takeover
sections.body: March Madness is big business for Buffalo Wild Wings. Our homepage takeover ran the day after Sweet Sixteen weekend ended, a time when most people’s brackets became seemingly worthless. So we gave them a few useful things to do with their useless bracket.

sections.title: BWW Film School
sections.body: We gave fans of Buffalo Wild Wings a shot at making their own BWW commercials. A lot of comedy ensued. Both intentional and otherwise. Participants were able to upload, vote and share their videos with friends (before Meta owned all of that).

title: XBOX Kinect
intro: Gatorade is constantly looking for new ways to allow teen athletes to experience what it’s like to fuel and train like the pros. We took Gatorade athletes Paul George, JJ Watt and their trainers into XBOX owners’ living rooms using Kinect and XBOX Fitness. Athletes could refine their technique, challenge their fitness levels and see how they measure up to real pros.

title: Tobacco Cessation
intro: Utilizing alternative media, we targeted smokers where they were practicing the very behavior we wanted to influence. This was a more cost-effective approach versus traditional paid media, and gave us a chance to make a deeper emotional impact.

sections.title: Ashcan Graves
sections.body: Graves were added to preexisting ashcans in high-rise commercial buildings with designated smoking areas.

sections.title: Smoker's Memorial
sections.body: Amping up the emotion through more specific targeting, “roadside-style” memorials were created for cancer victims who worked in high-rise buildings. These memorials gave insight into the death of someone who the audience may have recognized as a fellow smoker.

title: Winter Efficiency
intro: As someone who grew up in Florida, I severely felt winter's pain points when moving to a colder climate. We used the negatives of inefficient appliances as our inspiration to promote seasonal rebates and show Laclede Gas customers that they can live more comfortably.

title: Seresto & K9 Advantix II
intro: Playing off the circular nature of the Seresto collar, we highlighted the reciprocal love people and pets have for one another. For K9 Advantix II, we created two characters, neighbors having a casual conversation about flea and tick protection. They just happen to be talking dogs. A unique combination of 3D and 2D animation enabled us to give these dogs their voice.
productionCredit: K9 Advantix II Director: Dean Blumberg

title: BOGO TV
intro: Publix is beloved by shoppers all over the Southeast. One of the big reasons why is their numerous Buy One Get One Free sales events. We created simple, visually intriguing spots to drive home the idea that “everything good comes in pairs.”
productionCredit: BOGO Breakfast & BOGO Park Director: Rob Pritts
BOGO Paper & BOGO Pairs Director: Mike Bigelow
